counting_contract: document-local source-backed event rows after current corpus admission and deduplication

superseded_legacy_expectation.reason: The legacy expectation did not match the versioned corpus admitted by ITIR-suite PR #6. Corpus rows were not fabricated or duplicated to satisfy it.

source-backed event lineage admitted by the current scorecard

future_change_rule: A future count change requires a new baseline revision with source-revision, admission, deduplication, and event-lineage evidence.
